subject: DECISION REQUIRED: JLTV Production Rate Increase - FY26
bodyPreview: Sir, TACOM requests your concurrence on a proposal to increase Joint Light Tactical Vehicle (JLTV) production rate from 420 to 550 units per month starting Q2 FY26...

body.content:
Sir,

TACOM requests your concurrence on a proposal to increase Joint Light Tactical Vehicle (JLTV) production rate from 420 to 550 units per month starting Q2 FY26.

Rationale:
- Accelerate HMMWV replacement timeline by 18 months
- Meet increased demand from allied partner nations
- Leverage economies of scale to reduce unit cost by 8%
- Oshkosh Defense has confirmed production capacity

Cost Impact:
- Requires $215M acceleration of FY27 funding into FY26
- Saves $340M over program lifecycle due to efficiency gains
- Net program savings: $125M

Risks:
- Supply chain stress on specific components (mitigated through vendor agreements)
- Requires coordination with PEO Ground Combat Systems

Request decision NLT 25 November to maintain production schedule.

Respectfully,
COL Jennifer Hayes
Project Manager, JLTV
TACOM
